rankingModel.formula: weight(i) = (N - i + 1) / (N * (N + 1) / 2), where i is the 1-indexed position of the criterion and N is how many criteria the posting uses.
rankingModel.score: aiRankScore = round( sum over criteria of weight(position) * application.criterionScores[criterionId] ). Scores are 0-100.
rankingModel.scoresAreStoredForEveryCriterion: Each application carries a score and a note for ALL criteria in the catalog, not only the ones the posting currently uses. That means the recruiter can both REORDER the chosen criteria and SWAP one out for another, and the UI recomputes the whole candidate list client-side with no server round trip.
rankingModel.postingUsesThreeToFive: A posting's rankingCriteria array holds between 3 and 5 criterion ids, in priority order. Position 1 is the highest priority.
rankingModel.explainabilityRule: Show the note for the TWO highest-weighted criteria. If the candidate's score on that criterion is >= 70 present it as a reason; if < 55 present it as a concern; between 55 and 69 present it neutrally. Reasons and concerns must change when the recruiter reorders the criteria — they are derived, never stored as prose.
rankingModel.eligibilityRule: Candidates with profileCompleteness < 70 are not scored at all (aiRankScore is null) and appear in a separate 'Not yet rankable' group.
rankingModel.humanInTheLoop: Ranking orders a list. It never rejects, filters out, or hides a candidate, and it never makes a hiring decision.

criteriaCatalog.label: Regional experience

criteriaCatalog.description: Already holds the right to work in the school's country — no relocation package or work permit needed.
